tiers.text: Look at Black's king. Which squares next to it are weak?
Can you force a Black piece onto a line where it gets pinned?
Your queen is the piece to use.
Qxg7+ gives up your queen. Black has to take with the queen, and then that queen is pinned by your bishop.
Black's queen is stuck on g7. What can it no longer protect?
Rxf8# is checkmate! Black's queen can't take back because it's pinned to the king.
